english.note: Use this more formal expression when discussing the essential nature of something in analytical or written contexts.

exampleSentences.english: The issue is intrinsically a policy matter, not a technical one.
exampleSentences.traditional: 本質上，呢個問題係政策問題，唔係技術問題。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bun2 zat1 soeng6 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hai6 zing3 caak3 man6 tai4 m4 hai6 gei6 seot6 man6 tai4

english.note: Use this when you mean something is true in its intrinsic nature or essence, rather than merely true in practical terms.

exampleSentences.english: This plant is essentially a parasitic plant.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢種植物本質上係寄生植物。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 zung2 zik6 mat6 bun2 zat1 soeng6 hai6 gei3 sang1 zik6 mat6
